stepstone.goal: Hop your frog across the stones to the flag.
stepstone.how-to-play.step-1: The stone you stand on shows how you hop next.
stepstone.how-to-play.step-2: Tap a stone your hop reaches to land there.
stepstone.how-to-play.step-3: Each stone you leave sinks behind you.
stepstone.how-to-play.step-4: Reach the flag within par for three stars.
stepstone.name: Stepstone
stepstone.tagline: Each stone picks your next hop.
stepstone.tutorial.step-1: Tap a lit stone to hop there.
stepstone.tutorial.step-2: This × stone hops you corner to corner.
stepstone.tutorial.step-3: The stone you left has sunk, so plan ahead.
stepstone.tutorial.step-4: Hop onto the flag to win!
